exe: PathOfExileSteam.exe installed, built 2026-11-17, read as a file (signatures.py, capstone); checked on six archived builds
rules: each signature hits once in .text; displacements, immediates and branch operands wildcarded; >= 12 fixed bytes; value per build is what signatures.py check reads ("0 hits" = gone)
contradictions: Breach: [ruleset+0x190] is a std::vector of 8-byte POINTERS to separately allocated 0x48-byte encounters, not inline 0x48-byte records. Update 0x172a630 walks it with add rdi,8 and mov rax,[rdi]; slot 14 0x172a0f0 the same; the packet reader 0x172ab40 divides its byte length by 8 (sar rcx,3), allocates each with operator new(0x48) (0x172ac99) and frees with sized delete 0x48 (0x172abea). RulesetReader.Records(BreachEncounters, BreachStride) reads first + i*0x48: it must read the pointer at first + i*8 and the fields from there. BreachStride (0x48) is the object size, not a stride, so no line was made for it. The same pointer-vector shape (sub/sar of the vector length after lea +0x190) is in 25244054 and 26579160.

Fog GainFactor +0x70, ExtraDelay +0x74 and Never +0x8E are only ever addressed relative to the balance block at +0x58 (the chooser 0x1f67060 and Front/Rear 0x1f67140/0x1f671b0 take this+0x58 and use +0x18, +0x1C, +0x36): no instruction in .text has those displacements on the ruleset, so no line can read them as 0x70/0x74/0x8E. The values themselves agree (0x58 + 0x18/0x1C/0x36).
RulesetRow +0x30 is a dword row index (mov [rcx+0x30], ebx after movsxd rbx, r8d), not a pointer to the row.
